segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 42 seats and the May 15 go-live, and make sure the service package matches what your team needs.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We reviewed it internally. The 42 seats is right for phase one. We may add another 10 in Q4, but not on this order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So the initial subscription stays at 42 named users, annual term from May 15 through May 14 next year. The software line is $38,640, and implementation is a one-time $6,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On implementation, is that still the four-week plan with two admin trainings and one reporting workshop?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Two 90-minute admin sessions, one 60-minute reporting workshop, and configuration support through go-live. If you want a third admin session later, we can add it, but it is not required.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, two should be fine. For billing, we need the invoice dated after May 1. Our finance team won't process it before then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's fine. We can issue the invoice on May 2 with net 30 terms. Payment due would be June 1. Does that line up with your purchasing cycle?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. And the contract term, there is no auto-renewal longer than one year, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. It renews annually unless either side gives 30 days' notice. No multi-year commitment in this version.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the final order form to me and copy procurement. If it matches what we discussed, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form and the implementation outline today, and then we can hold May 15 as the target go-live once it's signed.
